pos.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung 2014 calls Atletico a 'counter-team' that attacks quickly even in forced possession, and Ballverliebt 2012 notes pressing then retreating. Possession is a means, not a goal, though the 3-5-2 era (Football Espana 2020) took more of the ball.

pro.personaBrief: Ballverliebt 2012 stresses the first three seconds after winning the ball, and Goal 2020 notes lethal three-pass breaks. Direct, vertical, safe in midfield, not pass-out-under-press.

est.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice and Spielverlagerung describe a rigid 4-4-2 with defined zonal screening and compact lines, with wingers narrowing into half-spaces rather than staying on the touchline. Roles are fixed and drilled; Griezmann-type strikers do drop but the team is not rondo-based.

lar.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung 2014: wingers set up in midfield to occupy half-spaces and compactness; Coaches' Voice: force the ball wide defensively. Later wing-backs in the 3-5-2 (Football Espana 2020) add width, so the team prefers central compactness with flanks used by full-backs.

blo.personaBrief: Deep compact 4-4-2 (Into the Calderon 2016, Coaches' Voice) with a mid-block and high press only in bursts (Ballverliebt 2012, Goal 2020). Forwards press the pivots; the default is dropping and waiting.

mar.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice explicitly frames his 4-4-2 as zonal screening with sliding lines. Corner defence is unverified, so I rely on the open-play zonal evidence.

pla.personaBrief: A strong, imposed identity across spells (fifa.com 2015: same ideals from Estudiantes to Atletico), but with tactical tweaks like the 4-1-4-1 against Chelsea and variable press height (Spielverlagerung 2014). Keeps the plan and adjusts details.

res.personaBrief: partido a partido mantra, 'defender antes que atacar' (El Debate 2022), Goal 2020: not precious but effective. Results over beauty, closing games with a defensive change.

sis.personaBrief: Publico 2014: collective above the individual; benching Joao Felix who does not buy the defend-first speech (El Debate 2022); Into the Calderon: develops versatile role players. System and duty over free-roaming stars.

jog.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung 2014 praises intensity and workrate (Diego Costa brawn), Publico: intensity every second, set-piece and aerial emphasis (Simeone 2025: good headers). Physical intensity valued over classic technique.

bas.personaBrief: Atletico squad built through signings and a small consistent core (Spielverlagerung 2014), heavy rotation in 2022, development of versatile players like Koke and Saul. Not an academy-first or youth-first philosophy.

lid.personaBrief: Publico 2014: philosophy imposed inside and outside the pitch, team above any individual; benching stars like Joao Felix (El Debate 2022). Strong authority, rules for all, less negotiation.
